# Iron Tuna

> Iron Tuna is a fantasy football **auction draft** site. Where every other fantasy tool publishes a ranking, Iron Tuna publishes dollars: it prices all 500+ players for your exact league — your teams, your budget, your roster slots, your scoring — and gives three numbers on every player instead of one. It runs a live Auction Manager on draft night and an AI "Value Coach" that answers "do I go to $41 here?" against the roster you have already bought. A snake-draft assistant is also available for readers who play that format, but the auction is what the site is built for.

## The three numbers (this is the whole idea)
- **Proj** — the going rate: what the room is likely to pay, on the price curve your league's budget actually produces.
- **Value** — what he is worth: his projected points converted to dollars against a replacement-level starter. The honest price, whatever the room does.
- **You** — your max bid: what one more dollar buys *your* lineup, given the players you have already won and the money left in your pocket.

A ranking cannot answer any of those questions, which is why an auction drafter armed with one is guessing.

## What it does
- Free auction values for every player, calibrated to your league — no signup.
- A one-time $9.99 unlock rebuilds every value for your league's exact custom scoring, lets you reorder the board, and includes the live draft-day tools.
- A live AI Value Coach that answers questions and gives team-specific advice from planning through draft night.
- Tiered cheat sheets, a budget-aware lineup planner, and unlimited mock auctions.
- Values are blended with the betting market (game lines via nflverse) and refreshed daily, so a price moves when the market moves rather than when a ranker gets round to it.

## Auction draft tool (the flagship) — https://irontuna.com/auctiondraft
- The three numbers above, on every row of the cheat sheet.
- A budget-aware optimal-lineup planner that solves, exactly, the highest-scoring starting lineup your budget can buy.
- Live prices that adjust to the room as money leaves it, plus proactive reads on emerging bidding trends.
- Supports salary-cap, keeper, Superflex and 2-QB auction formats.

## Snake draft tool — https://irontuna.com/snakedraft
- Custom rankings for your exact scoring, with ADP, tier-cliff alerts, and survival odds (the chance each player lasts to your next pick).
- The AI Value Coach tells you who to draft on the clock based on your roster needs and what is likely to be gone by your next turn.

## Key facts
- Price: free to start (expert default values). One optional one-time upgrade ($9.99) unlocks your league's custom scoring, board reordering, the live in-draft tools, and the Value Coach.
- No account or password sharing required; enter or paste your league settings. Purchasers can restore access on another device with a one-tap email magic link.
- Runs entirely in the browser and keeps working on draft night even if Wi-Fi drops.
- Best for: fantasy football **auction** drafts of any settings; snake drafts are supported too.

## FAQ
- Is it free? Yes — the auction board with expert default values is free, no signup. The one-time $9.99 upgrade rebuilds every value for your league's exact custom scoring and adds board reordering, the live draft tools, and the Value Coach.
- Is it only for auctions? Auction is what it is built for and the only format that gets max-bid maths and room-wide budget tracking. Snake is supported; you can switch to it from the ribbon on the home page.
- Does it work for any league? Yes — including salary-cap, keeper, Superflex and 2-QB formats, and any custom scoring.
- How is it different? Most tools give one generic ranking. Iron Tuna gives three dollar figures per player, calibrated to your league, blended with the betting market, plus a real-time AI Value Coach that advises you bid by bid.
